claims.citation: New York Herald, 4 June 1866, p. 5, col. 5
claims.verbatim:
Bark J Godfrey, Cooper, Palermo March 10, and Gibraltar
April 13, with fruit, &c, to Wakeman, Gooain[?] & Dickinson.
Had a prevalence of westerly winds during the passage;
been 12 days on soundings, with calms and light airs from
SE.
